editorial:
If you loved the first Equalizer, you're in for more of the same slow-burn action with Denzel Washington back as Robert McCall. This time around, he's living a quiet life as a Lyft driver while secretly helping people who can't help themselves. When his close friend and former partner Susan is murdered, McCall drops everything and goes on a globe-trotting hunt for the killers. The vibe is darker and more personal than the first film, with McCall's calm, methodical style contrasting against the brutal violence he dishes out. It's a revenge story at its core, but it also spends time showing McCall mentoring a young neighbor and reflecting on his past.

Denzel is fantastic as always, bringing weight and quiet intensity to every scene. The action is well-staged, especially the final showdown during a hurricane, which is genuinely thrilling. On the downside, the pacing drags in the middle and the plot can feel a bit scattered with too many side stories. If you're a fan of Denzel or slow-burn action thrillers, this is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, McCall tracks the killers to his old hometown during a massive hurricane. He uses the storm to his advantage, taking out the mercenaries one by one in the flooded streets. The twist reveals that his former partner Dave York, who he thought was dead, is actually the mastermind behind Susan's murder. McCall confronts York in a brutal final fight and kills him. In the end, McCall returns to his quiet life, continuing to help those in need while keeping his deadly skills sharp.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Denzel Washington or revenge thrillers.
